title: A racing hand-off whose check threw never left the barrier, so the other hand-off and later calls waited forever
resolution: The barrier runs the check itself, leaves on a throw and rethrows the original error; three regression tests cover the error, the release, and reuse.

title: The fix commit was titled as work in progress and the record cited it
resolution: The unpushed branch was rebuilt from the base by cherry-picks with the commit retitled, the trees were compared, and the records cite the new commits.
